provenance.sourceName: NASA FIRMS SP · Kazakhstan 2024 · MODIS + VIIRS NOAA-20 · type0 / QA-filtered
provenance.processingMethod: All 366 request days per sensor verified; SHA-256; country clipping; type0; native confidence filtering; deduplication. Exploratory analysis separate.
limitations: All query windows covered; actual cloud-free satellite coverage is unknown. No non-detection zero-fill.
type0 is presumed vegetation burning, including agricultural burning; not confirmed wildfire.
Standard-processing MODIS Terra/Aqua versus NOAA-20 VIIRS; unequal overpasses and resolution remain uncorrected.
Same-year temporal holdout and block bootstrap are internal checks, not scientific validation.

MODIS.limitations: Низкая чувствительность к малым очагам (<1000 м); шкала достоверности 0–100%.

VIIRS.limitations: Архив начинается с 2012 г.; категориальная достоверность low / nominal / high.

annualSeries.completenessNote: Imported rows only. No coverage mask; no detections does not imply no fire.
